replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Too flat

The ring donut thing is very hurtful to an open eye. The stone and dirt amount don't mix together. Try putting in percentage ranges to mix up the coloring in stone and dirt.

The ring also looks unnatural. It just looks like you placed gravel on it then changed the block type.  Try messing around with Voxel sniper.

Change up the Grass and make it have more block variations. If the flooring is only grass, it will look plain.
